discovery_notes: DLR open-edition pass 2023-2024; 32 WebSearch calls (shared search budget exhausted before ~35), all search_snippet. Mostly Disney Pins Blog and WDWNT. Many OE lines are 'Disney Parks' releases sold at both DLR and WDW; included where snippet names Disneyland. 2023 dated series spotted Dec 2022; 2024 dated series Dec 2023. Disney100 Platinum Character pins released 27 Dec 2022 as Disney100 merchandise. OE prices rose Oct 2023 (silver 11.99->12.99, pink 14.99->16.99) per DPB. Leads not recorded as claims: Ariel/Prince Eric statue pin 14.99 (Jan 2023, source attribution unclear); Disney100 Mickey & Minnie and figural pins 14.99 Jan 2023 (edition unstated); 2024 OE lines at DL+WDW without named pins: Stitch (Mar), UP (Mar), Alice in Wonderland (Apr, 12.99-14.99), Nightmare Before Christmas (Jul, 12.99), Kingdom Hearts 2024. Toontown pins edition unstated; Tiana's Bayou Adventure Disneyland OE in 2024 not confirmed (booster set is 2025).
